description: Replaces a draft's `responseMatches`, `responseRedactions`, `paramValues`, or `geoLocation` in place; the `draftId` stays the same. Validates regexes and selectors and rejects a matcher that bakes a captured value in as a literal, or redactions that reveal more of the captured response than the draft did. Returns the secret-free provider and, unless `check` is false, a `check_matchers` result for the edit. Prefer `propose_provider` with a better request or target; use this to narrow or fix what it drafted.

check.description: Default true: run `check_matchers` on the edit.

geoLocation.description: ISO country the published version's request goes out from, for example `US`, or `{{DYNAMIC_GEO}}` (the default) for the verifying user's own country. Pin a country when run_proof only verified with that `geoLocation`.

name: update_draft
